This template is designed for the specific use of content that [[Wikipedia:D23 (Disney)|Disney D23]] releases exclusively through its [https://www.youtube.com/@DisneyD23 YouTube channel].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you do not use.

<code><nowiki>{{D23YouTube|video=|text=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the YouTube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{D23YouTube|YkkAeTG89Xo|Hidden Details Inside Dok-Ondar's that Every Fan Should Find &#124; Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|date=2019-06-01|archivedate=20230406153954}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{D23YouTube|YkkAeTG89Xo|Hidden Details Inside Dok-Ondar's that Every Fan Should Find &#124; Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|date=2019-06-01|archivedate=20230406153954}}
